name: web-search.record-attempt
purpose: Record an observed research attempt and explicitly verified finding contributions.
assumptions: Declared owner bindings are reachable. External answers require independent verification before claiming measured quality improvements.
invariants: One bounded envelope on every path.
Web Search validates research quality locally; lib.vrooli_memory.finish_attempt owns record and observation delivery.
The legacy outer receipt retains the attempt identity when observation delivery fails.

signals.contributing_finding_ids: Contributions persisted with the outcome; legacy counters are unchanged
signals.quality: Observed assessment persisted as a typed linked observation
signals.task_outcome: Observed task outcome, independent of capture success
signals.capture_status: complete, capture_failed, or unknown from shared finish
signals.retry_inputs: Exact shared finish inputs; retry with lib.vrooli_memory.finish_attempt unchanged

outputs.evidence: Durable references, never raw source bodies
